title: TAVELO GROW The ULTIMATE ALL ROAD Speed Machine!

takeaways.text: Size-L build with SRAM Force XPLR 1×13, 1,442 g hookless wheels (33 mm internal) and 45 mm Pirelli slicks weighed 8.31 kg with pedals, power meter, cage and mount.

Repeats Tavelo's 55 mm front / 50 mm rear clearance and 52T maximum 1× chainring; he says he has seen others fit about 57 mm front depending on rim, and his 45 mm tires measured about 47 mm with plenty of room.

Tavelo switched from BB86 press-fit (with which the earlier Arow had undersizing issues, he says) to a threaded BSA shell; FIDLOCK storage includes a tool bag, and breakaway spacers allow stack changes without bleeding brakes.

disclosure: Build walkaround by a US shop-owner YouTuber; how the frame was obtained is not stated, and he mentions Panda Podium-branded accessories.
summary: Walkaround of a size-L Tavelo Grow built as a fast all-road bike on 45 mm slick tires, with a weigh-in.
